answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 16089 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: salam.ager roza ki halat ma dantoo sa khone aa jay tu roza toot jata ha.allah hafize Question: salam.ager roza ki halat ma dantoo sa khone aa jay tu roza toot jata ha.allah hafize Answer ID: 16089 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1522/1523/M=1430) If the teeth bled while fasting and went inside throat, the fast will turn invalid if blood was more than saliva, but if the blood was less than saliva the fast will not be invalid. Likewise, if one spat the blood without swallowing, then also the fast will not be invalid, it will remain valid. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
